meta.description: Canonical roster of Annals local bots for the Mac Mini pool. Many definitions; concurrency is gated so they share 24 GB RAM and mostly do not run at once. Aggressive KeepAlive workers with immediate failure retry; still max 1 Ollama LLM. Mirrors Superstack platform-local-bots pattern.

throughput_targets.note: Single Ollama lane on :11434 (serialized enrich vs significance). KeepAlive workers + enrich-b waiter minimize idle. Scrapers ≠ 11434.
throughput_targets.entities_per_hour_target: 80–150 combined enrich+sig when Mini is quiet

appwrite_cutover.note: Local Docker Appwrite is the UI + sync target. Cloud merges create-if-missing via merge-cloud bot. New local docs never overwrite/push to cloud.

concurrency.principle: Many bot definitions are fine; concurrent RAM/CPU/Ollama use must stay gated. Leave headroom for Cursor/OS and Superstack's two daily media-house scrapers.

lanes.always_on: bot-server + healthcheck only; never blocked by scrap blackout
lanes.ollama: enrich + significance share one exclusive lock; never overlap
lanes.light: queue, kpi, push — may run beside light OS work; yield when scrapers are actively running
lanes.heavy_scan: audits + orphan triage + edges-extract — one at a time; skip during scrap blackout and when scrapers are live
lanes.network_write: sync — Appwrite writes; skip during scrap blackout

ollama.note: Annals uses default Ollama on 11434. Superstack news Ollama (11435) is separate when enabled; keep Annals on 11434.

superstack_blackout.description: Do not interrupt Superstack's ~2 daily media-house scrap bots. Annals heavy/LLM/network bots skip these windows and also yield when those LaunchAgents are actively running.

protected_scrapers.name: Daily new-article bot
protected_scrapers.note: 6:10pm Port of Spain fresh media-house harvest. Process-heavy scrape; do not compete for RAM/CPU.

protected_scrapers.name: Archive backfill, shallow houses first
protected_scrapers.note: 8:35pm Port of Spain one-house listing backfill.

windows.note: Narrow RAM/CPU buffer around 18:10 harvest. Scrapers do not use Ollama :11434; live process yield still pauses Annals if the LaunchAgent is running longer.
Narrow buffer around 20:35 listing backfill. Process yield covers overrun.

bots.name: Local Bot HTTP Server
bots.role: Curator command post on port 7474 — status, manual enrich/sig/queue/sync/push triggers, Ollama health.

schedule.note: KeepAlive + RunAtLoad. Not a cron job.

bots.name: Bot stack healthcheck
bots.role: Every 5 minutes: ensure Ollama responds, bot-server listens on 7474, restart server if needed. Does not start the legacy monolithic daemon when discrete launchd bots are installed.

bots.name: AI Enrichment (Ollama)
bots.role: Bulk entity enrichment via local Ollama. Writes git-first entity JSON; sync/push bots ship later.

schedule.note: Superstack-style */2 StartInterval. Soft-skips when significance holds ollama lock. Target ≤2 min idle. Ollama lane skips live-scraper yield (scrapers ≠ :11434) but still honors narrow calendar blackout.

bots.name: Significance Backfill (Ollama)
bots.role: historicalSignificance backfill via Ollama. Serialized against enrich (never concurrent LLM).

schedule.note: Same */2 cadence as enrich; file locks alternate the single LLM lane with minimal downtime.

bots.name: Enrichment Queue Regenerator
bots.role: Rescan weak entities into data/enrichment/queue.json. No LLM.

schedule.note: Every 30 min StartInterval so enrich never starves for candidates. Temporary: yield_on_scraper_process=false while Superstack media-daily runs long so queue can refresh past already-enriched heads.

bots.name: Local KPI Aggregator
bots.role: Roll up local_bot_status + audit/enrichment artifacts into Superstack-style 1h/week/month/YTD processed-volume KPI + mirror ui/public/governance for Curator pages.

bots.name: Local Stats Cache Refresh
bots.role: Recount local Appwrite entities into stats_cache (+ ui/public/governance/stats_cache.json) so /catalog, ClassHub, AuditDashboard show live counts.

schedule.note: Every 10 min. Ensures stats_cache exists on local Docker Appwrite.

bots.name: Git Push Pending Enrichments
bots.role: Commit + push dirty entity/enrichment/audit files so cloud GH Actions remain optional. Local Appwrite sync is the sync bot. No LLM.

bots.name: Local Sync Gateway
bots.role: Push _unsyncedEdits entity JSON to local Docker Appwrite via sync_gateway.ts --local. Budget-gated. Skip during scrap blackout.

schedule.note: Every 15 min StartInterval so enriched entities reach local Appwrite + audit_log quickly. Localhost writes — no live-scraper yield.

bots.name: Edges Extract (no LLM)
bots.role: Promote detailsJson.relationships into standalone edge records (--extract-only). No LLM.

schedule.note: Late morning, clear of scrap windows.

bots.name: Staged Git → Local Appwrite Seed
bots.role: Create-if-missing seed from data/appwrite-export into local Docker Appwrite (batched).

schedule.note: Every 20 min StartInterval while seeding local Docker Appwrite. Localhost writes — no live-scraper yield.

bots.name: Cloud → Local Create-If-Missing Merge
bots.role: One-way merge old cloud entity docs into local Appwrite. Never overwrites existing/local-only docs. Cursor in data/governance/cloud_merge_cursor.json.

schedule.note: Every 25 min while catching up cloud history. Outside narrow scrap blackouts via gate. Localhost writes — no live-scraper yield.

bots.name: Cloud → Local Audit Log Merge
bots.role: Create-if-missing merge of cloud audit_log into local so /curator/audit/log shows new local + old cloud entries (CLOUD badge via editorId / editorNote).

schedule.note: Keeps audit log populated with historical cloud edits alongside local Ollama/sync rows.

bots.name: Audit Stats
bots.role: Entity corpus stats report (git-first).

bots.name: Audit Completeness
bots.role: Completeness audit over local entity mirror.

bots.name: Audit Orphans
bots.role: Find entities with zero relationships.

bots.name: Orphan Triage Helper
bots.role: Export orphan CSV (legacy Nodes path when present) and regenerate orphan_triage.html for curator review.

bots.name: Audit Consistency
bots.role: Schema/consistency audit over local entity mirror.

bots.name: Audit Duplicates
bots.role: Weekly fuzzy duplicate scan.

bots.name: Audit Classification
bots.role: Weekly Dewey/classification validation.

retired_on_mac.note: scripts/local_bot_daemon.sh monolithic enrich+sig loop is superseded by discrete enrich/significance LaunchAgents. Do not enable both.
